The [[Rebel pilot/Legends|rebel pilot]] [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] had a '''friend''' during his time in the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. The friend was later tortured and killed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], driving Darklighter toward the rebellion.

==Behind the scenes==
The friend is mentioned in the [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]], aired by NPR in [[1981]].
